label: Sacred Political Order
description: The shared sacred-political structure that organizes political identity and meaning.

label: Institutional Embodiment
description: The degree to which institutions carry and enforce the order.

label: Self-Preservation
description: The embodied order acts to preserve its continuity and authority.

label: Crisis / Sacralization
description: Crisis conditions intensify sacred claims around survival.

label: Correction Capacity
description: Pluralism, review, limits, dissent, memory, and institutional design restrain pathological escalation.

label: Sacred Political Order Strength
description: Degree to which a sacred political order coherently organizes collective identity, legitimacy, obligation, memory, moral judgment, and sacrifice.
deprecationNote: Historical identifier preserved for compatibility; use sacred-political-order-strength for new analytical records.

label: Sacred Political Order Strength
description: Canonical score variable for the degree to which a sacred political order coherently organizes collective identity, legitimacy, obligation, memory, moral judgment, and sacrifice.

label: Sacralization
description: Degree to which an order, institution, leader, people, cause, memory, or territory is treated as morally non-negotiable and resistant to correction.

label: Collective Immortality
description: Degree to which mortal individuals are symbolically linked to an enduring collective body whose continuation gives meaning to death or sacrifice.

label: Sacred Enemy
description: Degree to which an opponent is represented as contaminating, existential, profaning, or morally absolute.

label: Pathology
description: Maladaptive self-preservation at the expense of truth, correction, personhood, and human flourishing.

label: Corrigibility
description: Capacity of an embodied order to receive criticism, acknowledge error, limit power, and repair harm.
